accept.criterion: One vote per audId, which can be changed until close (a quiz vote locks on the first answer)
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts -t "one vote per audId"
accept.evidence: vote/predict/dial ballots are replaced by a member's later input and frozen at close; a quiz member's second answer is ignored; invalid options are dropped

accept.criterion: Tallies go out at no more than 4 Hz, and reactions every 500 ms
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/units.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "no more than 4 Hz|batches counts every 500 ms|200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: 10 s of a vote change every 10 ms yields <= 41 tally frames, each >= 250 ms apart, and none when nothing changes; 1,000 reactions over 3 s go out as 6 batches >= 500 ms apart with every count preserved; the bot run checks tally spacing per poll

accept.criterion: A guess poll matches accept[] after normalisation, and the accept values never appear in any outgoing frame (the test greps serialized output)
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "guess poll matches accept|200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: accents, case, punctuation and spacing fold to the answer; Levenshtein 1 on a 5+ letter answer is only a private 'close' cue; 1.5 s cooldown and 32-char cap; every serialized frame (unit rig, and every bot/player/Stage socket in the bot run) is grepped for the answers, the guess texts and the accept key

accept.criterion: A dial poll produces a 50-bin histogram
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/units.test.ts -t "dial poll produces a 50-bin histogram|dial bins"
accept.evidence: live tallies and the result carry exactly the 50 bins 0..49 over 0..1000, with the mean; out-of-range and non-integer values are dropped; resolve scores the tightest band

accept.criterion: predict pays out pari-mutuel, and a balance never drops below 100
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/units.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "pari-mutuel|never drops below 100|never creates Seeds|200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: pool 600 / winning pool 200 pays +200 net per winner, -100 per loser; resolving twice pays once; 20 straight losses end at exactly 100; no winner backed = refund; stakes are capped at the balance above the floor (checked at vote and at resolve), so a member at the floor stakes 0 and total Seeds never rise after a resolve, including overlapping polls; proportional split and pool conservation unit-tested; 200 bots all stay >= 100

accept.criterion: Below audienceMin, the flag says the vote doesn't count
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "below audienceMin|200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: 4 voters with audienceMin 5: the game's result and the pollEnd frame carry counted=false; 5 voters: counted=true; the bot run's game sees counted=true for all 8 polls

accept.criterion: Stream delay is added to closesAtMs for closeOn: "deadline" polls; closeOn: "event" polls ignore it and discard inputs received after the close event
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "stream delay is added|200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: the delay is added once, by ctx.timing.input: a game poll built from timing.input(8 s) in a real room with streamDelaySec 3 is announced at exactly openedAt + 11 s (not +14 s) and closes at that instant; the aggregator announces and honours a timing.input deadline unchanged; an event poll keeps its closesAtMs, never closes on the deadline, and inputs after the close (same instant or later) are counted as late and dropped; room polls keep their window

accept.criterion: A hideLive poll broadcasts only total until close (frame grep: no per-option tallies before pollEnd)
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/aggregator.test.ts apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "hideLive poll broadcasts only total|200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: every tally frame of a hideLive poll has empty tallies and the running total; the serialized frames before pollEnd never contain an option id; pollEnd carries the full distribution

accept.criterion: Audience sockets are limited to 5 msg/s
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "limited to 5 msg/s"
accept.evidence: through the real RoomManager: a burst of 20 audience messages delivers 5 to the aggregator, then ~5/s; a player socket in the same room gets its higher limit

accept.criterion: Bot test: 200 seeded audience bots play one poll of every kind through a real room
accept.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run --project @sg/server --maxWorkers=2 apps/server/test/audience/audience-bots.test.ts -t "200 audience bots"
accept.evidence: vote, predict, quiz, dial, guess, tap, hideLive vote and an event-closed vote each open, tally and close; predict/quiz/dial resolve with personal pollEnd 'you' frames; leaderboard top 5 ranked
